privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.infoCollectText: We collect your email address, display name, and device information when you create an account. We do not access, store, or process the content of your video streams.
howWeUseList: To provide and maintain the Service
To manage your account and subscription
To improve the Service quality and performance
privacy.videoStreamDataText: All video and audio streams are peer-to-peer encrypted. BabyCam.io acts as a signaling intermediary only. Stream content is never recorded, analyzed, or stored on our servers unless you enable cloud recording (Pro feature).
privacy.paymentInfoText: Payment processing is handled by third-party providers (Stripe, PayPal, PayMongo, M-Pesa). We do not store credit card numbers or bank details. We only store transaction references and subscription status.
privacy.dataSharingText: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information. We may share data only when required by law or to protect our rights.
privacy.dataSecurityText: We use industry-standard encryption (TLS 1.3) and secure authentication tokens. API keys are stored encrypted. Access to user data is restricted to authorized personnel only.
privacy.yourRightsText: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time. Contact us at
privacy.cookiesText: We use essential cookies for authentication and session management only. We do not use tracking or advertising cookies on paid plans.
privacy.childrensPrivacyText: This Service is intended for parents and guardians monitoring their own children. We do not knowingly collect data from children under 13.
privacy.changesText: We may update this policy periodically. We will notify you of significant changes via email or in-app notification.

disclaimer.notSubstituteText: BabyCam.io is a monitoring tool and is NOT a substitute for proper in-person supervision of children, infants, or dependents. Parents and caregivers must always ensure appropriate physical supervision is maintained regardless of the use of this Service.
